mapper.insert: INSERT INTO first_visit_appointment ( appointment_no, student_id, form_id, interviewer_id, duty_schedule_id, appointment_date, slot_id, room_id, appointment_status, priority_flag, audit_admin_id, audit_time, audit_remark, cancel_reason, create_time ) VALUES ( #{appointmentNo}, #{studentId}, #{formId}, #{interviewerId}, #{dutyScheduleId}, #{appointmentDate}, #{slotId}, #{roomId}, #{appointmentStatus}, #{priorityFlag}, #{auditAdminId}, #{auditTime}, #{auditRemark}, #{cancelReason}, NOW() )
mapper.select: SELECT fva.id, fva.appointment_no, fva.student_id, su.real_name AS student_name, sp.student_no, sp.college, fva.form_id, fvf.main_problem, fvf.problem_description, fvf.risk_score, fvf.risk_level, fva.appointment_date, fva.slot_id, ts.slot_name, ts.start_time, ts.end_time, fva.room_id, cr.room_name, fva.interviewer_id, interviewer_su.real_name AS interviewer_name, fva.duty_schedule_id, fva.appointment_status, fva.priority_flag, fva.audit_admin_id, admin_su.real_name AS audit_admin_name, fva.audit_time, fva.audit_remark, fva.cancel_reason, fva.create_time, fva.update_time FROM first_visit_appointment fva LEFT JOIN sys_user su ON fva.student_id = su.id LEFT JOIN student_profile sp ON su.id = sp.user_id LEFT JOIN first_visit_form fvf ON fva.form_id = fvf.id LEFT JOIN time_slot ts ON fva.slot_id = ts.id LEFT JOIN counseling_room cr ON fva.room_id = cr.id LEFT JOIN staff_profile isp ON fva.interviewer_id = isp.id LEFT JOIN sys_user interviewer_su ON isp.user_id = interviewer_su.id LEFT JOIN sys_user admin_su ON fva.audit_admin_id = admin_su.id WHERE fva.id = #{id}
